source.title: What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?
source.description: Non-technical introduction to what MCP is: the USB-C analogy, example use cases, benefits for developers and users, and ecosystem adoption.

source.title: Architecture overview
source.description: MCP's host–client–server architecture, data and transport layers, JSON-RPC primitives (tools, resources, prompts, elicitation), stateless discovery, and notifications, with a message-exchange example.

source.title: Understanding MCP servers
source.description: Detailed reference on the three server primitives — tools, resources, and prompts: protocol operations, who controls each, user-interaction patterns, and combining multiple servers.

source.title: Understanding MCP clients
source.description: The host–client distinction and client features servers can use: elicitation (form and URL modes, MRTR flow), deprecated roots and sampling, and security and consent guidance.

source.title: Versioning
source.description: MCP's date-based protocol versioning: revision states, feature deprecation lifecycle, per-request version negotiation via `_meta` and `UnsupportedProtocolVersionError`, and compatibility with older handshake-based revisions.

source.title: Connect to local MCP servers
source.description: Claude Desktop tutorial: configure a local filesystem server via `claude_desktop_config.json` and `npx`, approve tool actions, and troubleshoot connection failures using logs.

source.title: Connect to remote MCP Servers
source.description: Tutorial: connect Claude (Desktop or browser) to internet-hosted MCP servers via Custom Connectors, authenticating with OAuth and configuring tool permissions.

source.title: Build with Agent Skills
source.description: Scaffolding MCP servers with AI coding agents via the `mcp-server-dev` plugin's Agent Skills, including deployment-path selection (remote HTTP, MCP apps, MCPB bundles, local stdio).

source.title: Build an MCP server
source.description: Tutorial: build a stdio weather server exposing `get_alerts`/`get_forecast` tools in Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, C#, Ruby, Rust, or Go, avoiding stdout logging, then test in Claude Desktop.

source.title: Build an MCP client
source.description: Tutorial: build a Claude-powered chatbot client that launches stdio servers, lists tools, and routes Anthropic API `tool_use` calls, in Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, C#, Ruby, or Rust.

source.title: Client Best Practices
source.description: Scaling hosts to hundreds of tools: progressive tool discovery (search meta-tools, dynamic server connection, caching) and programmatic tool calling in sandboxes (code mode), with security guidance.

source.title: SDKs
source.description: Table of official MCP SDKs by language (TypeScript, Python, C#, Go, Java, Rust, Ruby, Swift, PHP, Kotlin) with GitHub repository URLs, docs-site links, and support-tier classifications.

source.title: Debugging
source.description: Debugging MCP integrations: Inspector, stderr/OpenTelemetry logging, common stdio failures (working directory, environment variables), protocol error codes, and Claude Desktop logs and Chrome DevTools.

source.title: Example Servers
source.description: Catalogue of reference servers (Filesystem, Git, Fetch, Memory, Time, others) with links to official and community integrations, plus npx/uvx run commands and Claude configuration snippets.
